item.title: Campus Accessibility
item.description: We want CHR2027 to be welcoming and accessible to everyone attending the conference. Detailed information about the accessibility of the conference buildings and rooms will be added once the programme and room allocation have been confirmed. Access requirements and additional support We are happy to provide additional services and support where possible. If you have any access requirements or need specific arrangements in order to participate in the conference, please let the local organisers know as far in advance as possible by emailing local@computational-humanities-research.
